objective: Add versioned mission automation recipes, deterministic task materialization, and durable fleet activity projection.
rules: Recipes are coordination intent, not execution authority.
Mission Work remains canonical work state.
Workforce capability grants are not minted by recipes.
No second broker or authoritative state store.

security.auth: Authenticated recipe/activity APIs; mutations require EDITOR/ADMIN/OWNER.
security.capability: Managed workforce target agents must be ACTIVE and already possess requested capabilities.
security.metadata: Fleet activity persists a bounded allowlist of non-secret metadata.

validation.strix: INHERITED/UNPROVEN — cumulative Wave 3 security gate remains independent.

dispositionRationale: Wave 5 release remains cumulative with Wave 3. Wave 5 itself must pass focused typecheck/tests/Semgrep; cumulative release still depends on the inherited Wave 3 security requirement.
